en: Black‑and‑white view over a wooded hillside spa town with grand historic buildings. In the foreground on the right is a classical-style statue seen from behind, overlooking a curving path lined with many outdoor café tables and chairs. In the middle distance stands a large multi‑storey building with the word "RICHMOND" on its facade. Other large villas and hotels rise on the hill beyond. The word "Karlsbad" is printed on the white margin of the card.
